title: Affine Minimax Recovery of Exact Initiation-Time Risk in Illness-Death Models
banked_reason: D0.5 normalized subfield under field floor: paper score ceiling 6.6 < 7.4; no bounded field-tier fix, with four typed findings unresolved.
gap_reasons: It does not prove full Le Cam equivalence or an observed-experiment lower bound for arbitrary estimator sequences
The narrow subclass, iterated local scope, affine restriction, and limited comparison or applied evidence constrain the paper score despite the exact constants and feasible construction.
paper_score_ceiling 6.6 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the finite-subexperiment LAN and a sharp centered-affine Gaussian frontier, then developed a split-sample estimator for an initiation-flat independent-censoring subclass. D0.5 found four typed issues and graded the delivered package subfield because it lacks a full observed-experiment minimax lower bound and remains restricted to an affine, narrow-class analysis. Formalization did not start; a future field-tier re-raise needs a materially broader theorem and repair of the four recorded findings.
tldr: Exact initiation-time risk is nonregular, whereas existing illness--death inference fixes a positive initiation window. On the strict initiation-flat, independent-censoring, no-covariate subclass, the project derives the singular censored Gaussian martingale experiment at the \(n^{-1/3}\) scale, solves its affine MSE and honest fixed-length interval games exactly, and gives a data-only attaining procedure. It also proves the natural-window functional's jump drift and an observable off-window correction. The frozen source one-step estimator's shrinking-window expansion and source-interval coverage remain open; unrestricted estimation and variable-length intervals are outside the claim.
gap: The published source supplies a fixed-window influence function and conditional one-step central limit theorem, but no shrinking-window information experiment, exact affine decision constants, or feasible learned-weight transfer.
fill: The local martingale likelihood supplies the information geometry; least-energy tents and bias-aware critical values supply exact constants; normalized weighted risk-set ratios provide a concrete route to data-only attainment without fast pointwise hazard learning.
